text:
Sofia: Quick sync — vendor/marketplace ask: Gaudi + MI300 limited capacity next month. We need a short comms plan and integrator availability check. Who can own contacting integrators this week?
Omar: I can ping our top 3 SI partners (CloudWorks, Nimbly, AtlasOps). Do we have firm dates from partners yet?
Sofia: Not yet. Tamas from partner HW said tentative GA hardware arrivals around 2026-06-10 for early batches, but that can slip. Need to prep both optimistic and conservative comms.
Raj: For Dedicated customers we need an opt-in cutover window. My ask: can platform accept a short-notice resize? Likely yes but need runway for autoscale tests.
Elena: Marketing: prefer a single announce week if at all possible. If hardware splits, we'll do a staged drip. Can you give me earliest safe announce date?
Omar: Earliest safe publicly: 2026-06-24 if partners confirm hardware and SIs can support integration testing by 6/18. Conservative: 7/8.
Sofia: OK — two parallel plans. Plan A (6/24) and Plan B (7/8). Anders — can Partner Ops confirm SI blackout windows and delivery SLAs?
Anders: I'm on it. Reached out to CloudWorks + AtlasOps for patch schedules. Also asked for a brief ETA matrix: model binary readiness, infra drivers, firmware. Will post updates.
Sofia: For Marketplace listing: we need SKU tagging, thermal/power icons, and a short HDR note for capacity. Raj, what's the minimal SKU metadata you need?
Raj: Minimal: model-name, vCPU/GPU count, memory, power draw, region availability, and driver version. Example: `Gaudi-2-medium | 8xH200 emu | 512GB | 850W | us-west-2 | driver v1.2.0`.
Elena: Also need hero image + 1-line compatibility note from partners. If we go with Plan B we'll push to a smaller initial cohort and a staged marketplace tag.
Omar: SI checklist I'm sending:
```
- infra validation runbook
- quantization test with Redwood runtime v3.1
- KV cache sanity check
- perf smoke (1k tokens/min per GPU)
```
Sofia: Can we get that checklist confirmed by EOD Fri? If so marketing can draft a press email and a customer advisory.
Anders: CloudWorks confirmed a two-day integration slot starting 6/15, AtlasOps may need 6/20. Nimbly hasn't replied yet.
Raj: Platform note: if AtlasOps slips, we can route initial traffic to Dedicated fallback (smaller instance size) for the first 72 hours. Need to test fallback by 6/12.
Elena: Small ask — if we commit to 6/24 we need embargo ops and press slots locked by next Tue. Who owns embargo?
Sofia: I'll coordinate embargo handshake with PR and partners. @release-bot can you create an embargo tracker doc and add these dates?
release-bot: Created embargo tracker: https://redwood.internal/embargo/1758349000 and added initial rows for Plan A/Plan B.
Omar: I'll follow up with Nimbly. Also — FYI partners asked about co-branded collateral. Marketing ok?
Elena: Yes, but require partner sign-off 48h before announce. Add it to the tracker.
Sofia: Summary actions:
- Omar: confirm SIs and return checklist by Fri EOD.
- Anders: finalize ETA matrix and firmware/drivers table.
- Raj: run fallback test by 6/12 and confirm autoscale runbook.
- Elena: draft press + partner collateral, tentatively for 6/24, fallback 7/8.
- Sofia: embargo handshake + vendor comms.
Sofia: We'll reconvene Thu 10:00 PT for a quick pulse. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
